series.title: The Gull Rock Inheritance
series.note: SEASON PLAN, broken before writing (docs/DRAMA.md). A London nurse inherits a Cornish hotel from a stranger, on one condition: she must live in it for a year. Lead: Maya Rao, 29, night-shift A&E nurse in London. Asha Rao, her mother, in Leicester. Edward Hale, the dead hotel owner. Clara Hale-Wynn, his daughter. Richard Wynn, Clara's husband, a property lawyer. Tom Penrose, the hotel's old night porter. Daniel Mercer, a young engineer who died in 1997 (Maya's real father). Gerald Wynn, Richard's late father, a developer. Season question: why did a stranger leave Maya everything? PROMISES: P1 the brass key tagged 14 (planted ep1, paid ep8); P2 the missing 1997 ledger pages (planted ep2, paid ep7); P3 Asha avoids room 14 (planted ep3, paid ep5); P4 the sealed letter in the will (planted ep5, paid ep8); P5 Tom saw two men on the cliff (planted ep5, paid ep8).

episodes.title: The Letter
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Maya Rao comes off a night shift in a London A&E to a solicitor's letter: Edward Hale, owner of the Gull Rock Hotel in Cornwall, a man she has never heard of, has left her the whole hotel, on condition she lives in it for twelve months. His daughter Clara rings her the same afternoon and calls it a fraud. Maya takes the train to Cornwall to see it: a tired white hotel on a cliff, half its rooms shut. The night porter, Tom Penrose, carries her bag up and says, 'He said you'd come.' PLANT P1: in Edward's desk drawer, a heavy brass key on a wooden tag marked 14; room 14 is the only door Tom says has been locked since before his time. ENDS ON: under the key, a photograph: a young woman holding a baby on the hotel steps, and Edward beside them. The woman is Maya's mother. The baby is Maya.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: The Photograph
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Maya phones her mother, Asha, in Leicester and describes the photograph. Asha says she has never been to Cornwall and ends the call. Clara's husband, Richard Wynn, a polished property lawyer, takes Maya to lunch and offers her two hundred thousand pounds to sign the hotel over and go home. Maya, who has eleven thousand pounds of debt, nearly says yes, and says no. Clara, alone with Maya, is colder and more honest: her father missed her school plays and paid for strangers. PLANT P2: in the hotel office, the guest ledger for 1997 has pages cut out with a blade, the whole summer gone. ENDS ON: a taxi pulls up at midnight. Asha gets out, uninvited, in her work coat. Tom the porter stops in the doorway and says to her, 'You came back.'
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: What Asha Hid
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: In the hotel kitchen at one in the morning, Asha admits she worked at Gull Rock as a chambermaid in the summer of 1997, at nineteen, and left in the autumn, pregnant, without telling anyone where she went. Maya decides Edward must be her father, and that the hotel is a guilty man's apology. Clara, furious, demands a DNA test before anything else is signed; Richard arranges it within a day. PLANT P3: Asha walks every corridor of the hotel except the one with room 14, and takes the back stairs to avoid it. ENDS ON: the DNA result arrives by email while the three women sit in the lounge. Edward Hale is not Maya's father.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: Room Fourteen
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: If Edward was not her father, why leave her everything? Maya uses the brass key and opens room 14 (P1 shown again). It has been kept exactly as it was: dust, a made bed, a man's suitcase never collected. Inside, a passport for Daniel Mercer, aged twenty-four, a civil engineer, and a notebook of survey drawings of the cliff. Meanwhile Richard quietly approaches the hotel's bank about its debts. Maya finds Asha's name written inside the notebook's cover, in a man's handwriting. ENDS ON: Maya shows Asha the passport. Asha sits down on the bed she would not go near and says, 'That's your father.'
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: The Storm of Ninety-Seven
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Asha tells it: she and Daniel, the young engineer surveying the cliff for a developer, fell in love that summer; he was planning to take her to Bristol. On the night of the September storm he went out to the cliff path and never came back; the inquest said he slipped. She could not bear the room or the place (P3 paid off). Clara discovers that her father paid Asha's rent in Leicester for years without Asha ever knowing who sent it, and her anger turns into confusion. PLANT P4: the solicitor mentions a clause in the will: a sealed letter, to be opened only when Maya's twelve months are up. PLANT P5: Tom, asked about the storm, says he saw two men on the cliff path that night, and one of them was Edward. ENDS ON: Tom adds, quietly, that Edward came back alone, soaked, and told him to forget what he saw.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: Two Men on the Cliff
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Did Edward kill Daniel and leave the hotel as guilt money? Maya believes it; Clara refuses to, and the two women argue on the cliff path in the wind, then, reluctantly, start looking for the truth together, because each needs it for a different reason. They learn the hotel's debt has been bought by a company nobody has heard of, which can now call it in. Richard tells Clara to stop digging, more sharply than he means to. ENDS ON: searching her late father-in-law's old papers in her own house for the company's name, Clara finds a photocopy of a 1997 Gull Rock guest-ledger page, one of the missing ones. The guest in room 12 that September was Gerald Wynn, Richard's father.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: The Missing Pages
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Gerald Wynn, a developer, wanted to build holiday flats on the Gull Rock cliff; Daniel's survey (the notebook in room 14) said the cliff was unsafe, which would have killed the deal. The missing ledger pages (P2 paid off) are in Richard's study: he found them after his father died and has kept them. Richard tells Clara the company buying the hotel's debt is his, to bury the past and the cliff with it, for the family's sake. Clara does not know whose side she is on. Maya realises Edward did not push anyone: he was the second man on the cliff, and the will's sealed letter must say what happened. ENDS ON: Maya calls the solicitor to ask about the letter. It was signed out of his office last week, by Richard Wynn.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: The Letter Opened
episodes.covers: FINALE, LANDS: Clara chooses. She brings Maya the brass key's second use (P1 paid off): the wooden tag hides a bank deposit-box number, and in the box is Edward's own copy of the letter (P4 paid off). Read aloud in the hotel lounge: on the night of the storm Edward saw Gerald Wynn and Daniel arguing over the survey, saw Gerald push him, and could not reach him in time (P5 paid off). Gerald offered money to save the failing hotel; Edward, ashamed, took it and kept quiet, and spent twenty-seven years paying Asha's rent and trying to find the words. Leaving Gull Rock to Daniel's daughter was the only apology left. Clara gives the letter and the ledger pages to the police; Richard, who hid them but harmed no one, gives a statement. The inquest is reopened. LAST IMAGE: a year later, Maya and Clara run the hotel together; Maya and Asha stand on the cliff path where Daniel walked, and Maya opens room 14 to guests for the first time.

series.title: Seven Days to the Wedding
series.note: SEASON PLAN, broken before writing. Mumbai, seven days before an arranged wedding; each episode is one day, so the clock is the spine. Lead: Ananya Mehra, 27, architect. Vikram Mehra, her father, a retired bank manager. Meera Mehra, her mother, died in 1999 when Ananya was a baby. Kabir Malhotra, 30, her fiance, runs his family's struggling textile business. Sunita Malhotra, his mother. Tara Malhotra, his younger sister. Raj Malhotra, Kabir's late father. Deepak Shah, Raj's former business partner, now a rich developer. Mr Shinde, the old night guard of the Malhotra warehouse. Season question: who is sending the voice notes, and what are they trying to stop? PROMISES: P1 Vikram turns Meera's ring on his finger when nervous (planted ep1, paid ep8); P2 Sunita will not delay the wedding even a day (planted ep1, paid ep6); P3 the voice notes to Ananya are in a woman's voice (planted ep1, paid ep5); P4 Tara records the company's audio messages and always starts 'Just so you know' (planted ep2, paid ep6); P5 Raj's diary (planted ep3, paid ep7-8).

episodes.title: Seven Days Left
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Ananya Mehra, an architect in Mumbai, is seven days from her arranged wedding to Kabir Malhotra, a quiet, kind man she has met nine times and is starting to like. At the first function, the house full of marigolds and relatives, Kabir's mother Sunita refuses a suggestion to move the date: 'Not even by a day' (P2). PLANT P1: Ananya's father Vikram turns her late mother's ring on his little finger whenever the Malhotras talk about money. That night a voice note arrives from an unknown number, a woman's voice slowed down and low (P3): 'Ask Kabir why the Malhotras need this wedding.' ENDS ON: at three in the morning a second message arrives: a photograph of a bank document, a loan guarantee for the Malhotra company, signed by her father.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: Six Days Left
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: At breakfast Vikram says the guarantee is an old favour between families and changes the subject, turning the ring (P1). Ananya asks Kabir directly at a fabric shop; he goes quiet and says, 'Please trust me for six more days.' PLANT P4: Kabir's younger sister Tara, who barely speaks to Ananya, records the company's voice messages to its buyers and always begins them 'Just so you know.' A second voice note: 'Ask your father where your mother worked.' ENDS ON: Ananya visits the Malhotra office to surprise Kabir and sees a bank notice on his desk: the company is weeks from collapse, and if the loan fails, the bank comes for the guarantor, her father's flat.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: Five Days Left
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Ananya has always been told her mother Meera died in 1999 of an illness. She searches old newspapers at the Asiatic Library and finds a short report from the same month: a night fire at the Malhotra textile warehouse in Bhiwandi, one person dead, the firm's accountant. PLANT P5: at the Malhotra house, she hears Sunita tell Tara to 'leave your father's diary where it is.' The night's voice note says only: 'It wasn't an accident.' ENDS ON: the accountant's name in the report is Meera Mehra. Her mother.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: Four Days Left
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Ananya confronts her father on the terrace. Vikram admits it: Meera died in the Malhotras' warehouse fire. Raj Malhotra paid compensation, came to every birthday, and before he died asked that their children marry, to make the families one; Vikram agreed out of gratitude, and later signed the guarantee when Sunita asked. He never told Ananya because he could not say the words. Ananya feels like a debt being settled. ENDS ON: Kabir arrives at her door after midnight, shaken, and shows her his phone. He has been getting voice notes too, in a man's voice. The latest says: 'Her father started the fire.'
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: Three Days Left
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: For the first time Ananya and Kabir talk honestly, in an all-night cafe, and play their messages side by side. Hers are a woman's voice; his are a man's (P3 paid off): two senders, telling two different stories. They find the warehouse's old night guard, Mr Shinde, now living with his grandson in a one-room flat; he remembers Meera, who worked late every night that month going through the books, and told him she had found 'something that will make Raj Sahib very angry.' ENDS ON: Shinde says that on the night of the fire he saw a second man leave the building ten minutes before the smoke: Raj's business partner, Deepak Shah. Kabir goes white. Deepak Shah is the developer who has offered to buy the Malhotra company next week.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: Two Days Left
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: At the sangeet, the music night, Deepak Shah arrives as guest of honour, charming, generous, an old family friend. Ananya sees the shape of it: if the wedding is called off, her father withdraws the guarantee, the bank calls the loan, and Deepak buys the company for almost nothing. That is why Sunita would not move the date (P2 paid off), and why somebody wanted Kabir to believe her father started the fire. In a quiet room Ananya plays her own voice notes again at normal speed, and hears the opening of one she had skipped: 'Just so you know.' ENDS ON: it is Tara's voice (P4 paid off).
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: One Day Left
episodes.covers: WHAT HAPPENS: Tara admits it. After their father died she found his diary (P5): Raj wrote that Meera had warned him Deepak was stealing from the firm, that he did not listen, and that he always believed Deepak set the fire to burn the books. Raj never had proof and kept quiet to save the company's name, and arranged the marriage out of guilt. Sunita forbade Tara to tell anyone, so Tara sent the notes, wanting the truth out before Ananya married into a lie. Ananya and Kabir decide to take the diary and Shinde to the police. ENDS ON: the diary is gone from Tara's cupboard. Sunita is standing in the doorway holding it. 'If this comes out,' she says, 'there is no company, no wedding, and nothing left for any of us.'
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map

episodes.title: The Wedding Day
episodes.covers: FINALE, LANDS: The wedding morning. Ananya is dressed and walks toward the mandap, the wedding canopy, still not knowing what she will do. In the front row Vikram is turning Meera's ring on his finger (P1 paid off). Sunita sees it, and something in her gives way: she walks across the hall and puts the diary in Ananya's hands. Ananya and Kabir stop the ceremony, not to cancel it but to postpone it, and go with Tara, Shinde and the diary to the police; the 1999 fire is reopened and Deepak Shah is questioned and later charged. The company is sold honestly, small but alive. LAST IMAGE: months later, a small wedding by the sea, chosen rather than owed; Vikram slips Meera's ring onto Ananya's finger.
episodes.source: Original fiction: the season plan in this map
